image_description: A close-up, slightly angled shot of a metal shelving unit densely packed with audio cassette tapes. The cassettes are arranged vertically, showing their spines which feature various band names (e.g., Radiohead, Queensryche, Rancid) and titles. To the left, there is a spiral-bound notebook and a green plastic bag. The lighting is artificial, casting slight shadows within the shelf compartments.
